_comment: Worked example. Image fields are LOCAL paths relative to this file's folder (scripts/imports/<slug>/); the import script uploads them to Blob and rewrites them to URLs. An already-hosted https URL may be used as-is. `cardImage` (gallery card) and `ogImage` (OG/social card) are separate slots — set both when you have distinct assets, or leave `ogImage` null to fall back to `cardImage`. Delete this _comment in a real manifest.
name: Tidemark
summary: A macOS menu-bar app that tracks how long you've spent in each app and nudges you when a focus block runs long.

sections.title: Live timeline
sections.description: Tidemark sits in the menu bar and records the frontmost app every few seconds. The timeline shows your day as a stacked bar — one glance tells you where the hours went, no manual timers to start or stop.

images.caption: A full day, app by app

sections.title: Focus nudges
sections.description: Set a soft limit per app. When you cross it, Tidemark taps you on the shoulder instead of locking you out — the choice to keep going stays yours.

images.caption: A nudge after 90 minutes in the browser

sections.title: Local-first
sections.description: Everything stays on your Mac. No account, no sync server, no telemetry — the data never leaves the device, and you can export it as CSV whenever you want.
